name: Netflix
steps: Sign in to Netflix in a browser and open your account's Manage membership page.
Select Cancel.
Select Finish Cancellation to confirm.
Check for the confirmation email. If another company bills you for Netflix, cancel with them instead.

name: Spotify
steps: Sign in to your Spotify account page in a browser.
Go to Manage your plan.
Select Cancel subscription and confirm.
Premium stays until your next billing date, then the account switches to free.

name: Canva
steps: Sign in to the Canva account or team that pays for the plan.
Open your account menu, then Settings, then Billing.
On your plan, select Cancel plan and follow the prompts to confirm.
If you subscribed through Apple, Google Play, or PayPal, cancel there instead.

name: ChatGPT
steps: Sign in to ChatGPT on the web.
Open your account menu and select Settings, then Billing.
Under Cancel plan, select Cancel.
If you subscribed in the iOS or Android app, cancel through the App Store or Google Play instead. Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal.

name: Notion
steps: In Notion's sidebar, open Settings, then Billing, then Change plan.
Select the Free plan (or a cheaper plan) and click Continue.
Give feedback if asked, then click Downgrade.
Check the confirmation for the date your current plan ends.

name: YouTube Premium
steps: Sign in to YouTube with the account that pays for Premium.
Open your paid memberships page.
Choose your membership and select the option to cancel (you may be offered a pause instead).
Confirm the cancellation.

name: Disney+
steps: Sign in to Disney+ in a web browser.
Open your profile, then Account.
Select your Disney+ subscription and choose Cancel Subscription.
If you're billed by Apple, Google, Amazon, or another provider, cancel through them instead.

name: Amazon Prime
steps: Sign in to your Amazon account.
Go to your Prime membership management page.
Select the option to end your membership and benefits.
Follow the prompts to confirm.

name: Apple
steps: On iPhone or iPad, open Settings and tap your name, then Subscriptions (or use the web option on Apple's support page).
Tap the subscription you want to stop.
Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm.
If you don't see Cancel, the subscription is already cancelled or billed by someone else.

name: Hulu
steps: Sign in to your Hulu Account page in a web browser.
Under Your Subscription, select Cancel.
Continue through the prompts and select Cancel Subscription.
If you're billed by a third party, check Payment Information on the Account page and cancel with that company.

name: HBO Max
steps: Go to HBOMax.com/subscription and sign in to see who bills you.
If HBO Max bills you, choose Cancel Your Subscription.
Confirm and note the date your access ends.
If Apple, Google, Amazon, Roku, or a TV provider bills you, cancel through them.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
steps: Sign in to your Adobe account and open Plans and payment.
Select Manage plan for the plan you want to cancel, then Cancel your plan.
Choose a reason, review the details, and select Confirm cancellation.
Check the terms first: some annual plans charge an early-termination fee.

name: Microsoft 365
steps: Sign in at account.microsoft.com with the account that bought Microsoft 365.
Open Services & subscriptions and find Microsoft 365.
Select Cancel subscription (it may say Upgrade or Cancel).
Follow the prompts and select I don't want my subscription. If you bought it from Apple, Google, or a retailer, cancel with them.

name: Dropbox
steps: Sign in to dropbox.com in a browser.
Open your account settings and go to the plan or billing section.
Choose the option to cancel or change your plan and confirm.
If you subscribed through the iOS or Android app, cancel through that app store.

name: Google One
steps: Go to Google One and sign in.
Open Settings.
Select Cancel membership, then confirm.
Paid storage stays until the end of the current billing cycle.

name: Duolingo
steps: Cancel in the same place you subscribed (web, App Store, or Google Play).
On the web: sign in, open Settings, select Super Duolingo, then Cancel subscription.
In the app: open the subscription settings and manage the subscription through your app store.
Deleting the app or your account does not cancel the subscription.

name: LinkedIn Premium
steps: Sign in to LinkedIn on desktop and open your profile menu.
Go to Premium features, then Manage subscription.
Select Cancel subscription and confirm.
Cancel at least one day before your next billing date.

name: Audible
steps: Sign in to the Audible website (deleting the app does not cancel).
Go to Membership details in your account.
Choose the option to cancel your membership and follow the prompts.
Use any remaining credits first; they may expire when the membership ends.

name: Grammarly
steps: Sign in to your Grammarly account in a browser.
Open your account's Subscription page.
Select Cancel Subscription, choose a reason, and confirm.
If you bought it through the App Store, cancel through Apple instead.

name: Xbox Game Pass
steps: Sign in to your Microsoft account's Services & subscriptions page.
Find the Xbox subscription and select Manage.
Turn off recurring billing (or choose Cancel) and confirm.
Benefits continue until the current period ends.

name: PlayStation Plus
steps: Sign in to PlayStation Account Management in a browser.
Select Subscription from the menu.
Select Cancel Subscription next to PlayStation Plus.
On a PS5, you can also go to Settings > Users and Accounts > Account > Payment and Subscriptions > Subscriptions.

name: Paramount+
steps: Sign in at paramountplus.com.
Open your account page.
Find Cancel subscription and confirm.
If you signed up through Apple, Roku, Amazon, or Google Play, cancel through that platform.

name: Peacock
steps: Sign in at peacocktv.com.
Open your account and go to plans or subscriptions.
Choose the option to cancel and confirm.
If you subscribed through Apple, Google, Roku, Amazon, or another provider, cancel through them.

name: GitHub Copilot
steps: Sign in to GitHub and open Settings.
Go to Billing & licensing, then Licensing.
Find Copilot, choose Manage subscription, then Cancel subscription.
If your organization provides Copilot, ask an organization owner instead.

name: Claude
steps: Sign in at claude.ai.
Open Settings, then Billing.
Select Cancel and confirm.
If you subscribed in the iOS or Android app, cancel through that app store. Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal.
